valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027 adjusted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: Slower data-center load ramp, higher interest rates, and equity dilution
bear.assumption: FY2027 adjusted EPS $4.90 (low end of guidance) at 19.0x P/E

base.driver: Execution toward upper half of 2027 guidance on industrial and data-center demand
base.assumption: FY2027 adjusted EPS $5.10 (upper half of $4.90-$5.20 guidance) at 23.0x P/E

bull.driver: Accelerated large-load signings and rate-base expansion above >8% CAGR

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 EPS of $5.10, the $111.15 close implies 21.8x; the 3-analyst equal-weight target of $124.33 implies 24.4x (or $5.41 EPS at 23.0x).
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $5.10 (4.6 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Large-load industrial and data-center signings and FY2027 adjusted EPS trajectory toward the upper half of $4.90-$5.20
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 / FY2026 earnings release and Form 10-K (expected February 2027)

analyst_notes: Following Q3 2026 earnings on November 2, 2026, Mizuho's Anthony Crowdell nudged his target up to $122 (from $121) while Scotiabank's Andrew Weisel trimmed his to $121 (from $129), both maintaining Buy-equivalent ratings. Earlier in October, JPMorgan's Jeremy Tonet lowered his target to $130 (from $137) with an Overweight rating. All three targets sit above our $117.30 base case (+5.5% upside), reflecting a ~1.4x higher implied P/E multiple (24.4x vs. 23.0x) on $5.10 FY2027 EPS.
